purpose: Edges between canonical_texts entries in /data/canon-sky/canon-stars.json, per the edge taxonomy in EA-STARMAP-01 v0.1 §3.2. These edges are the knowledge-graph relations that the starmap surface will render between stars: companion (paired readings), predecessor (earlier-in-tradition), superseded_by (versioned replacement), bundle (collection-relation), chain_predecessor (immediate-upstream chain), related (loose thematic), transform_of (kernel-transform output relation; passes through the transform substrate).
status_note: Initial population derived from the manifest's stated relationships and from the existing canon-stars entries' anchor_for_constellation / transform_substrate / cluster fields. transform_of edges between individually-named source and transform canon-stars are pending — currently the TACHYON pair and the Feist function/force pair are bundled as single entries containing both sides. When those split into separate canon-stars entries, transform_of edges will be added here passing through the producing substrate per §3.2.

edge_kinds.companion: Texts that operate as a paired or grouped reading.
edge_kinds.predecessor: Earlier-in-tradition text that the later text reads / responds to.
edge_kinds.superseded_by: Earlier text whose canonical role is taken by a successor.
edge_kinds.bundle: Collection-relation: source text belongs to the target collection (or vice versa).
edge_kinds.transform_of: Kernel-transform output relation; the visualization passes through the substrate sphere that produced the transform.
